text: On the fixed 300-item ARC-Challenge test subset, llama3.1:8b Q8_0 minus Q4_K_M strict accuracy was +1.67 pp (95 % paired bootstrap CI -1.00 to +4.33; exact McNemar p = 0.332, b = 11, c = 6): no detected difference, not equivalence
scope: this machine (M1 Pro 16 GB), Ollama 0.9.6, template T1, greedy decoding
status: supported by frozen rule (H0 not rejected)
limitations: minimum detectable difference about 9 pp; single benchmark; one runtime

text: Runtime-reported model memory (/api/ps size) was 9,162.4 MiB for Q8_0 versus 5,872.0 MiB for Q4_K_M
limitations: runtime accounting, not an independent measurement

text: Median per-item end-to-end latency was 437.7 ms for Q8_0 versus 477.5 ms for Q4_K_M (ratio 0.917); median decode throughput 40.1 versus 53.9 tokens/s; median prefill throughput 245.3 versus 214.4 tokens/s
scope: this machine, Ollama 0.9.6, prompts mostly of 65 to 128 tokens (1,295 of the 1,495 records per arm that follow the first; JRN-0009 E4), num_predict 8
status: descriptive; the frozen bootstrap interval for the latency ratio is not implemented (gap reported to the owner)
limitations: short outputs make latency prefill-dominated; no CI

text: ministral-3:8b (installed) cannot be described or run by the installed Ollama 0.9.6: its chat template calls the function currentDate, which this runtime does not define (HTTP 500)
limitations: explains the EXP-001 and EXP-002 failures; not a property of the model weights

text: EXP-001 and EXP-002 produced no confirmatory output (0 of 4,500 and 0 of 60 planned requests); the study makes no claim about A0 phi4-mini:3.8b versus A1 llama3.1:8b versus A2 ministral-3:8b, nor about cold-start penalties
status: reported as failed; owner choice pending (DL-011 a to c)
limitations: exploratory smoke values for A0 and A1 exist but are never evidence for EXP-001

text: In EXP-003 greedy outputs were identical across the five repetitions for every item in both arms (determinism 1.00), and accuracy was identical in every repetition
limitations: repetitions are not independent accuracy samples

text: Exploratory: the Q8_0/Q4_K_M end-to-end latency ratio was 0.917 [0.916, 0.918] as a ratio of medians and 0.916 [0.916, 0.917] as a median of per-item ratios; Q8_0 was faster on 296 of 300 items. Decode ratio over item medians 0.744 [0.743, 0.744]
status: exploratory; does not replace any frozen verdict; the frozen definition is pending (DL-011 gap 1)
limitations: intervals over items within one session; between-session variance unmeasured

text: Exploratory: prefill duration rose in steps across 32-token prompt-length bins in both arms and was lower for Q8_0 in every bin
scope: this machine, Ollama 0.9.6, prompt lengths in the E4 bins (up to 192 tokens)

text: Exploratory: the discarded warm-up repeats each block's first item; those 10 records were 102 to 135 ms against at least 325 ms for every other record, and removing them leaves the medians of per-item medians unchanged (477.5 and 437.7 ms)
scope: frozen runner as used in RUN-EXP-003-0001

text: Strict and lenient extraction (S2) gave the same contrast (+1.67 pp, b = 11, c = 6); strict format failures were 15 Q4 records on 3 items and 20 Q8 records on 4 items, all recovered by lenient extraction; excluding the 5 items with any strict format failure gives +1.36 pp (exploratory, post hoc)
status: S2 does not change the conclusion; post hoc exclusion is exploratory only
limitations: protocol section 9 forbids excluding items after outputs; the exclusion is not a valid confirmatory analysis

text: S3: per-repetition median latency moved from 478.1 to 477.4 ms (Q4) and from 440.0 to 437.8 ms (Q8) between the first and last repetition (drift below 1 %, under the 10 % trigger); arm position within a repetition moved median record latency by less than 1 ms
limitations: one session; slower thermal regimes not covered

type: external (sources opened 2026-11-24; dettmers2022kbit full text checked 2026-11-25 at pp. 2 and 8 of arXiv v2)
status: verified against the opened pages (full text for dettmers2022kbit since M6)
limitations: hardware of the llama.cpp table not recorded

The observed discordant proportion was 0.057 (17 of 300) against the planning assumption 0.25, and the observed 95 % CI half-width 2.67 pp against the planned 5.66 pp; no equivalence margin is frozen, so this is not an equivalence test
type: confirmatory result compared with a planning value (exploratory comparison)
limitations: post hoc; not a power or equivalence analysis

text: The runtime-reported memory ratio (1.56) is lower than the ratio of the model files (8,540,789,934 bytes against 4.92 GB, about 1.74); a shared KV-cache and runtime allocation at num_ctx 2048 is a plausible but unverified explanation
type: measured values plus an unverified interpretation
